# Fivecast

> > Fivecast provides AI-powered OSINT solutions for national security, financial crime compliance, and risk intelligence across defense, law enforcement, and commercial sectors.

Fivecast specializes in open-source intelligence (OSINT) analytics using artificial intelligence and machine learning through its flagship platform, Fivecast ONYX. The company serves defense agencies, law enforcement, and commercial organizations with solutions for threat detection, KYC/AML compliance, fraud prevention, and security vetting.

## Key Topics

- OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence)
- Fivecast ONYX platform
- Generative AI for intelligence analysis
- National security and defense intelligence
- Financial crime compliance (AML/KYC)
- Fraud detection and prevention
- Insider threat detection
- Security vetting and screening
- Foreign influence operations
- Critical infrastructure protection
- Risk assessment and due diligence
- Social media intelligence
- Violent extremism monitoring
- Dr. Brenton Cooper (leadership)
- Australia and United States operations

## OSINT Solutions and Use Cases

- [OSINT for the Commercial Sector - Industry Brief](https://www.fivecast.com/educational-resources/osint-for-the-commercial-sector-industry-brief): Industry brief on OSINT for KYC, AML, fraud detection & due diligence
- [Fraud Detection - Solution Brief](https://www.fivecast.com/educational-resources/fraud-detection-osint-solution-brief): Solution brief on Fivecast ONYX for fraud detection via AI & OSINT
- [AI-Driven Online Insights: Modernizing KYC Investigations](https://www.fivecast.com/educational-resources/ai-driven-online-insights-modernizing-kyc-investigations): Industry brief on AI-driven online data for KYC & EDD investigations
- [The intersection of Geo-Political and Business Risk - Industry Brief](https://www.fivecast.com/educational-resources/the-intersection-of-geo-political-and-business-risk-industry-brief): Industry brief on geo-political risk, supply chain & employee screening
- [Discover & Assess Foreign Influence - Case Study](https://www.fivecast.com/educational-resources/foreign-influence-osint-case-study): Case study on using OSINT to detect & assess foreign influence operations

## AI and Intelligence Analysis

- [How Generative AI Transforms Open-source Intelligence](https://www.fivecast.com/blog/how-generative-ai-transforms-open-source-intelligence): Dr. Trent Lewis explores GenAI's transformative impact on OSINT workflows
- [OSINT for security vetting and screening](https://www.fivecast.com/blog/osint-for-security-vetting-and-screening): Dr. Cooper on OSINT & GenAI for security vetting & insider threat detection

## Threat Intelligence and Security

- [WHAT IS 4CHAN?](https://www.fivecast.com/blog/what-is-4chan): Explains 4chan, 8chan/8kun risks & violent extremism via OSINT analysis
- [Shifting from Cyber to People to Protect Critical Infrastructure](https://www.fivecast.com/blog/shifting-from-cyber-to-people-to-protect-critical-infrastructure): People-centric critical infrastructure risk management under SOCI Act
- [UK Riots- The Role of Social Media in Misinformation & Violence - Industry Brief](https://www.fivecast.com/educational-resources/uk-riots-the-role-of-social-media-in-misinformation-violence-industry-brief): OSINT analysis of 2024 Southport riots & social media misinformation impact
